svg.title: Documentation placement
svg.desc: Documentation placement decision tree. If no external reader needs the information, keep it internal when an operator needs it or contains private context, otherwise review whether the page has a task. If an external reader needs it, split it into a public task page and a private record when private context remains, otherwise publish it externally.

text.tspan: Does an operator need it, or

svg.text: Split keeps one public task page and moves the private operating record out of it.
